entities.name: Jean-Claude Lefèbvre
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Claude Lefebvre was a French basketball player who was a member of the French national basketball team. He played two seasons of college basketball in the United States for Gonzaga University where he set the schools then single game scoring record with 50 points in 1958.

entities.summary: Jean-Claude Lefebvre was a French basketball player who was a member of the French national basketball team. He played two seasons of college basketball in the United States for Gonzaga University where he set the schools then single game scoring record with 50 points in 1958.
